account.pageTitle.note: Title of the account page in the browser tab, one word.

account.home.note: Link at the top of the account page, back to the start page. The arrow is part of the text.

account.heading.note: Main heading of the account page, one word.

account.error.status.note: Message line of the account page after a failed request when the server sends no text. {status} is the HTTP status code, for example 502.

account.invitation.heading.note: Heading of the box that shows a waiting invitation to a team.

account.invitation.fromInviter.text: {inviter} invites you to the team “{team}” ({handle}), with the role {role}. The invitation is valid until {expires}.
account.invitation.fromInviter.note: Text of the invitation box. {inviter} is the handle of the person who invites, {team} the name and {handle} the address of the team, {role} a team role (account.role.*), {expires} the date and time when the invitation ends.

account.invitation.fromNobody.text: You are invited to the team “{team}” ({handle}), with the role {role}. The invitation is valid until {expires}.
account.invitation.fromNobody.note: Text of the invitation box when the account that invited is gone. {team} is the name and {handle} the address of the team, {role} a team role (account.role.*), {expires} the date and time when the invitation ends.

account.invitation.alreadyMember.text: You are a member already, role {role}.
account.invitation.alreadyMember.note: Sentence after the text of the invitation box when the user is in the team already. {role} is the team role of today (account.role.*).

account.invitation.signIn.text: Sign in or register. Then accept the invitation here.
account.invitation.signIn.note: Hint in the invitation box for a visitor who is not signed in.

account.invitation.dismiss.note: Button in the invitation box, one word. It hides the invitation in this browser and does not decline it.

account.invitation.joined.text: You are now in the team “{team}”, role {role}.
account.invitation.joined.note: Message line after the user accepts an invitation. {team} is the name of the team, {role} a team role (account.role.*).

account.confirm.heading.note: Heading of the box that the link of the confirmation mail opens.

account.confirm.intro.text: Enter the password that you chose when you registered. Only the e-mail and the password together confirm the account.
account.confirm.intro.note: Text of the confirmation box, above the password field.

account.field.password.note: Label of a password field, one word: confirm, sign in, register and delete the account.

account.confirm.done.text: Your account is confirmed. You can sign in now.
account.confirm.done.note: Message line after the account is confirmed.

account.intro.text.text: With an account, the server keeps your maps. You open them on any device, and you share them to read with link or in public. Without an account, your maps stay in your browser,
account.intro.text.note: Lead text for a visitor who is not signed in. The link account.intro.startPage and a full stop follow it.

account.intro.startPage.note: Link at the end of the lead text account.intro.text. A full stop follows it.

account.tab.register.note: Tab of the registration form, one word.

account.tab.forgot.note: Tab of the form that asks for a link for a new password.

account.field.email.note: Label of an e-mail field: sign in, register, forgot password and invite to a team.

account.login.doneOpening.text: You are signed in. The map opens …
account.login.doneOpening.note: Message line after the sign-in from a map whose session ended, while the page goes back to that map.

account.register.handle.note: Label of the field for the handle at the registration. The handle is part of the address of the public maps.

account.register.handleHint.text: 3 to 30 characters: a–z, 0–9 and hyphens. Your public maps are then at
account.register.handleHint.note: Hint below the handle field of the registration. The example address account.register.handlePath and a full stop follow it.

account.register.handlePath.note: Example address after account.register.handleHint, the path after the address of the site. Keep the leading /; name stands for the chosen handle.

account.register.passwordHint.text: At least 12 characters. Long sentences and uncommon words make a password strong. Symbols, digits and capitals are optional.
account.register.passwordHint.note: Hint below each field that sets a password: the registration, the new password from the link of the mail, and the change of the password. The strength meter follows it.

account.strength.score0.note: Label of the strength meter below a new password, score 0 of 4. The server refuses it.

account.strength.score1.note: Label of the strength meter below a new password, score 1 of 4. The server refuses it.

account.strength.score2.note: Label of the strength meter below a new password, score 2 of 4. The server refuses it.

account.strength.score3.note: Label of the strength meter below a new password, score 3 of 4. The server still refuses it.

account.strength.score4.note: Label of the strength meter below a new password, score 4 of 4, the score that the server takes.

account.strength.short.note: Label of the strength meter below a new password while the password is shorter than 12 characters. {count} is the number of characters that are still missing.

account.strength.long.note: Label of the strength meter below a new password when the password is too long. {max} is the largest number of characters.

account.strength.warn.common.text: This is one of the most common passwords.
account.strength.warn.common.note: Warning of the strength meter below a new password: the password is in the list of common passwords.

account.strength.warn.similar.text: This is close to a common password.
account.strength.warn.similar.note: Warning of the strength meter below a new password: the longest part of the password is a common password.

account.strength.warn.word.text: A single common word is easy to guess.
account.strength.warn.word.note: Warning of the strength meter below a new password: the password is one common word.

account.strength.warn.names.note: Warning of the strength meter below a new password: the longest part of the password is a first name or a last name.

account.strength.warn.personal.text: It contains your name, your e-mail address or the name of this site.
account.strength.warn.personal.note: Warning of the strength meter below a new password: the password contains the handle, the e-mail address or a name of the site.

account.strength.warn.keyboard.text: Rows and patterns of keys are easy to guess.
account.strength.warn.keyboard.note: Warning of the strength meter below a new password: the longest part of the password is a row or a pattern on the keyboard.

account.strength.warn.repeat.text: Repeats like “aaa” or “abcabc” are easy to guess.
account.strength.warn.repeat.note: Warning of the strength meter below a new password: the password repeats characters or has fewer than 4 different characters.

account.strength.warn.sequence.text: Sequences like “abc” or “6543” are easy to guess.
account.strength.warn.sequence.note: Warning of the strength meter below a new password: the longest part of the password is a sequence of letters or digits.

account.strength.warn.dates.text: Years and dates are easy to guess.
account.strength.warn.dates.note: Warning of the strength meter below a new password: the longest part of the password is a year or a date.

account.strength.tip.moreWords.text: Add another word or two. Uncommon words are best.
account.strength.tip.moreWords.note: Tip of the strength meter below a new password, for every score below 4.

account.strength.tip.capitals.text: A capital at the start, or all capitals, helps little.
account.strength.tip.capitals.note: Tip of the strength meter below a new password: a word of the password starts with a capital or has only capitals.

account.strength.tip.substitutions.note: Tip of the strength meter below a new password: the password swaps letters for similar characters.

account.strength.tip.reversed.text: A word spelled backwards is hardly harder to guess.
account.strength.tip.reversed.note: Tip of the strength meter below a new password: the password has a common word spelled backwards.

account.register.submit.note: Button of the registration form, one word.

account.checkMail.text: If the details are right, we sent you an e-mail. Please follow the link in it.
account.checkMail.note: Message line after a registration and after a request for a new password. It does not say whether the address has an account.

account.forgot.submit.text: Send a link for a new password
account.forgot.submit.note: Button of the forgot password form.

account.reset.heading.note: Heading of the box that the link of the reset mail opens.

account.field.newPassword.note: Label of the field for a new password: in the reset box and in the form that changes the password.

account.reset.done.text: Your new password is set. Please sign in.
account.reset.done.note: Message line after a new password from the link of the reset mail.

account.who.note: Line below the main heading. {handle} is the handle and {email} the e-mail address of the account.

account.profile.link.note: Link to the public page of the user, before the page knows its address.

account.profile.linkTo.note: Link to the public page of the user. {address} is its web address.

account.profile.alsoAt.note: Second link after the public page of the user or of a team, when the server has subdomains. {address} is the address on the subdomain.

account.logout.button.note: Button at the top of the view of a signed-in user.

account.maps.heading.note: Heading of the list of the own maps.

account.maps.none.note: Shows instead of the list when the user has no map of his own.

account.newMap.label.note: Label of the title field of the form for a new personal map.

account.newMap.titlePlaceholder.note: Placeholder in the title field of a new map, one word. In the forms of a personal map and of a team map.

account.newMap.template.note: Label of the choice of the template of a new map, one word.

account.template.default.note: Choice in the list of templates: the default set, a small template of three areas with two categories and two skills each.

account.template.empty.note: Choice in the list of templates: a map without content, one word.

account.newMap.create.note: Button that creates a new map, one word.

account.newMap.done.note: Message line after a new personal map. {title} is the title of the map.

account.import.label.note: Label of the file field of the import form.

account.import.submit.note: Button that imports a map file, one word.

account.import.done.note: Message line after the import of a map file. {title} is the title of the new map.

account.visibility.private.note: Visibility of a map, one word: in the line below its title and in the choice of the visibility.

account.visibility.link.note: Visibility of a map: in the line below its title and in the choice of the visibility.

account.visibility.public.note: Visibility of a map, one word: in the line below its title and in the choice of the visibility.

account.map.version.note: Part of the line below the title of a map. {version} is the number of its version.

account.map.start.note: Part of the line below the title of a map: the map shows at the public page of its owner. Glossary: start map.

account.map.linkOn.note: Part of the line below the title of a map that has its read link.

account.map.linkPaused.note: Part of the line below the title of a private map that has a read link: the link does not work while the map is private.

account.map.visibilityLabel.note: Accessible name of the choice of the visibility of a map, one word.

account.map.visibilityDone.note: Message line after a change of the visibility. {visibility} is the new visibility (account.visibility.*).

account.map.rename.note: Button of a map, one word.

account.map.renamePrompt.note: Question of the browser dialog that asks for the new title of a map.

account.map.links.note: Button of a map, one word. It shows the read link of the map.

account.map.export.note: Link of a map that saves its map file, one word.

account.map.delete.note: Button of a map, one word.

account.map.deleteConfirm.note: Question of the browser dialog before a map goes. {title} is the title of the map.

account.map.deleted.note: Message line after a map is deleted.

account.map.moveLabel.note: Accessible name of the choice that moves a personal map into a team.

account.map.moveChoice.note: First entry of the choice that moves a personal map into a team. The teams follow it.

account.map.moveConfirm.text: Move the map “{title}” into the team “{team}”? It becomes private: its public addresses stop working, its read link is deleted, and no other website embeds it.
account.map.moveConfirm.note: Question of the browser dialog before a map moves into a team. {title} is the title of the map, {team} the name of the team.

account.map.moved.text: The map “{title}” is now in the team “{team}”.
account.map.moved.note: Message line after a map moves into a team. {title} is the title of the map, {team} the name of the team.

account.shares.none.text: No link yet. A read link lets others read the map, also without an account.
account.shares.none.note: Shows in the box of the read link when the map has none.

account.shares.label.note: Accessible name of the field with the read link of a map.

account.shares.copied.note: The button account.shares.copy for a moment after a copy.

account.shares.copyByHand.note: The button account.shares.copy for a moment when the browser does not let the page copy.

account.shares.private.text: The map is private, so the link does not work right now. It works again when the map is shared with link or public.
account.shares.private.note: Note below the read link of a private map.

account.shares.created.note: Line below the read link. {date} is the date and time when the link was made.

account.shares.renew.note: Button below the read link. It asks first (account.shares.renewWarning). Then the link stops working, and a new link takes its place.

account.shares.renewWarning.text: The current link stops working at once, also in frames on other websites. Whoever has it can no longer read the map. Only the new link works, and you share it again.
account.shares.renewWarning.note: Second step after the button account.shares.renew: says what the new link does before it happens.

account.shares.renewConfirm.text: Yes, revoke and generate new link
account.shares.renewConfirm.note: Button of the second step after account.shares.renew: revokes the link and makes a new one.

account.shares.renewCancel.note: Button of the second step after account.shares.renew: keeps the link as it is.

account.shares.renewed.text: New link. The old link no longer works.
account.shares.renewed.note: Shows above the read link after account.shares.renewConfirm.

account.shares.create.note: Button in the box of the read link of a map without one.

account.teams.heading.note: Heading of the section of the teams, one word.

account.teams.none.text: You are in no team yet.
account.teams.none.note: Shows instead of the list when the user is in no team.

account.team.yourRole.note: Part of the line below the name of a team. {role} is the team role of the user (account.role.*).

account.team.memberCount.note: Part of the line below the name of a team. {count} is the number of its members.

account.team.mapCount.note: Part of the line below the name of a team. {count} is the number of its maps.

account.team.open.note: Button of a team, one word. It shows the members, the maps and the settings of the team.

account.team.close.note: Button of an opened team, one word.

account.team.publicPage.note: Link in an opened team to the page with its public maps.

account.team.membersHeading.note: Heading of the members in an opened team, one word.

account.team.mapsHeading.note: Heading of the maps in an opened team.

account.team.noMaps.text: The team has no map yet.
account.team.noMaps.note: Shows instead of the maps of a team that has none.

account.newTeam.heading.note: Heading of the form for a new team.

account.team.name.note: Label of the name field of a team, one word: a new team and a renamed team.

account.newTeam.handle.note: Label of the field for the handle of a new team. The handle is part of the address of its public maps.

account.newTeam.handleHint.text: 3 to 30 characters: a–z, 0–9 and hyphens. The public maps of the team are then at
account.newTeam.handleHint.note: Hint below the handle field of a new team. The example address account.newTeam.handlePath and a full stop follow it.

account.newTeam.handlePath.note: Example address after account.newTeam.handleHint, the path after the address of the site. Keep the leading /; address stands for the chosen handle.

account.newTeam.submit.note: Button of the form for a new team.

account.newTeam.done.note: Message line after a new team. {name} is the name of the team.

account.role.owner.note: Team role, one word: in the lists of members and invitations, in the choice of a role, and as {role} in other texts.

account.role.editor.note: Team role, one word: in the lists of members and invitations, in the choice of a role, and as {role} in other texts.

account.role.reader.note: Team role, one word: in the lists of members and invitations, in the choice of a role, and as {role} in other texts.

account.member.you.note: Mark after the handle of the user in the list of the members of a team.

account.member.roleLabel.note: Accessible name of the choice of the role of a member. {handle} is the handle of the member.

account.member.roleDone.note: Message line after a new role of a member. {handle} is the handle of the member, {role} the new role (account.role.*).

account.member.leave.note: Button at the own entry in the list of the members.

account.member.leaveConfirm.note: Question of the browser dialog before the user leaves a team. {team} is the name of the team.

account.member.left.note: Message line after the user left a team. {team} is the name of the team.

account.member.remove.note: Button at a member in the list of the members, one word.

account.member.removeConfirm.note: Question of the browser dialog before an owner removes a member. {handle} is the handle of the member.

account.member.removed.text: {handle} is no longer in the team.
account.member.removed.note: Message line after an owner removed a member. {handle} is the handle of the member.

account.teamMap.label.note: Label of the title field of the form for a new map of a team.

account.teamMap.done.note: Message line after a new map of a team. {title} is the title of the map.

account.teamImport.label.text: Import a map file into the team
account.teamImport.label.note: Label of the file field of the import form of a team.

account.teamImport.done.note: Message line after the import of a map file into a team. {title} is the title of the new map.

account.invite.heading.note: Heading of the form that invites a person into a team, one word.

account.invite.role.note: Label and accessible name of the choice of the role in the invitation form, one word.

account.invite.hint.text: The invitation is valid for 7 days. The person accepts it with any account.

account.invite.sent.text: If the address is right, the invitation is sent.
account.invite.sent.note: Message line after an invitation. It does not say whether the address has an account.

account.invitations.heading.note: Heading of the list of the open invitations of a team.

account.invitations.until.note: Part of an entry in the list of the open invitations, after the e-mail address and the role. {date} is the date when the invitation ends.

account.invitations.withdraw.note: Button of an open invitation, one word.

account.invitations.withdrawn.note: Message line after an owner withdrew an invitation. {email} is the e-mail address of the invitation.

account.invitations.none.note: Shows instead of the list when a team has no open invitation.

account.manage.renameHeading.note: Heading of the form that changes the name and the address of a team.

account.manage.handle.note: Label of the field for the handle of a team in the rename form, one word.

account.manage.save.note: Button of the rename form of a team, one word.

account.manage.saved.note: Message line after a team got a new name or address.

account.manage.deleteHeading.note: Heading of the form that deletes a team.

account.manage.deleteText.text: This deletes the team with all its maps, links and invitations.
account.manage.deleteText.note: Text of the form that deletes a team.

account.manage.password.note: Label of the password field of the form that deletes a team.

account.manage.deleteSubmit.note: Button of the form that deletes a team.

account.manage.deleteConfirm.text: Really delete the team “{team}” and all its maps?
account.manage.deleteConfirm.note: Question of the browser dialog before a team goes. {team} is the name of the team.

account.manage.deleted.note: Message line after a team is deleted. {team} is the name of the team.

account.settings.heading.note: Heading of the section with the settings of the account, one word.

account.exportAll.text: Download all your own maps as a ZIP file
account.exportAll.note: Link that saves every own map as a map file in one ZIP file.

account.password.heading.note: Heading of the form that changes the password.

account.password.current.note: Label of the field for the password of today in the form that changes the password.

account.password.submit.note: Button of the form that changes the password.

account.password.done.note: Message line after the password is changed.

account.delete.heading.note: Heading of the form that deletes the account.

account.delete.text.text: This deletes your account and all your maps with their links. Teams in which you are alone go with it. You cannot undo this.
account.delete.text.note: Text of the form that deletes the account.

account.delete.submit.note: Button of the form that deletes the account.

account.delete.confirm.text: Really delete the account and all maps?
account.delete.confirm.note: Question of the browser dialog before the account goes.

account.delete.done.text: Your account and your maps are deleted.
account.delete.done.note: Message line after the account is deleted.
